description: Get the newest Apartment Therapy articles, search by keyword across the live feed and public archive, or browse a home-and-design category.

authorFilter.description: Keep only articles whose author name contains this text (case-insensitive).
authorFilter.title: Author Filter

category.description: Topic to browse. Used when mode=browseCategory; `main` means all topics.
category.title: Category

feed.description: Which Apartment Therapy feed to read: main (home & design), tech (home technology), or all.
feed.title: Feed

maxItems.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1–200).
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPages.description: How many historical RSS snapshots to scan beyond the live feed. 1 = live feed only; 20 = deepest available history.
maxPages.title: History Depth

mode.description: What to scrape: getLatest (newest articles), searchArticles (keyword search across the live feed and archive), or browseCategory (browse a topic).
mode.title: Scraping Mode

query.description: Keyword(s) to search in titles, summaries, categories and tags. Used when mode=searchArticles.
query.title: Search Query

sortBy.description: Result order. relevance suits keyword searches; newest and oldest sort by publish date.
sortBy.title: Sort Order

title: Apartment Therapy Scraper Input
